title: Subaru WRX Engines by Year (2002–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the US Subaru WRX and WRX STI by year, 2002–2026: the EJ205, EJ255 and EJ257 turbo boxers, the FA20DIT and the 2.4 FA24DIT.
intro: Subaru brought the turbocharged Impreza WRX to the US for 2002 and the STI for 2004. Every engine is a turbocharged flat four. The STI ended after 2021.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: Impreza WRX (GD/GG)
intro: The 2.0 EJ205, the 2.5 EJ255 from 2006, and the EJ257 in the STI.

generations.name: Impreza WRX (GR/GV)
intro: The EJ255 and, in the STI, the EJ257.

generations.name: WRX (VA)
intro: The 2.0 FA20DIT and the EJ257 in the STI, including the limited Type RA and S209.

generations.name: WRX (VB)
intro: The 2.4 FA24DIT; there is no STI.
